description_en: Creates an asynchronous prediction task for Document AutoML
description_zh: 文档自学习创建异步预测任务接口
kebab_example: aliyun documentautoml create-model-async-predict --model-version V1 --binary-to-text false --content https://doc-automl-public.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/3/1559855998794593/stage/upload/20230206/oss-hlfCRJ1SorSWs10MkqxK6YcL4OVAFSv4.png0Expires=1675665563_OSSAccessKeyId=XXXX_Signature=WLKghBc3zKzWJ3Td69%2B4C21jrbE%3D --model-id 123 --service-name pre_train_service --service-version V1 --biz-body data:image/png_base64,xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateModelAsyncPredict

parameters.help_en: The model version. If unspecified, the latest active model version is used
parameters.help_zh: 模型对应的版本号，如果不传入版本号表示默认用模型最新生效的版本
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.example:
false：表示content传入的是url
true：表示body是直接传入图片进行base64的内容
parameters.help_en: Specifies how the document content is provided
parameters.help_zh:
content字段是图片URL时：false
body为base64的内容时：true
parameters.name: binary_to_text

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image or PDF file
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The model ID. You can find this ID on the Model List Page in the console
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the pre-trained service
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The version of the pre-trained service
parameters.name: service_version

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded content of the document
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: The status code of the request. A value of `200` indicates that the request was successful

Data.description_en: A JSON-formatted string that contains the result. The `Data` field within this string is the asynchronous task ID
